ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling located in a large vertical-oblique patch on the mid-left lobe and a broad, irregular cluster on the outer-third of the right lobe. Low-intensity black pixels dominate the central region (peduncle area) and the leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 48 degrees; depth extends significantly into the fluke body from the trailing edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes. Pixel amplitudes of individual peaks range from 4 to 12 pixels, with higher frequency visible on the right lobe inner margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the outer lateral edges of the lobes, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast white calcified circular pixels (barnacle colonies) located on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned white linear pixel tracks (rake marks) are detected across the lower-center and right lobe areas, intersecting the dark pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive orange-brown pixel cluster (organic growth) located immediately to the right of the median notch; multiple white linear scars and localized depigmentation spots scattered across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged indentation/missing tissue section on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the median notch.
